v0.3.0.description:
# The Pokemon Sign Update
## New Features
* New (Custom) AP item: Pokemon Sign Detector. Required to photograph Pokemon Signs.
* Photographing each Pokemon Sign is now a check!
* A picture of each Pokemon Sign is in the item pool (not necessarily in your world!)
* Rainbow Cloud (the final stage) is locked behind having all six Pokemon Sign pictures.
* Better testing capability. Thanks @cobyw!
* New filler items: pictures of each Pokemon in the game

## Bug Fixes
* Default camera is now Normal instead of Reverse (who thought defaulting to Reverse was a good idea??)
* Photographing Mew now correctly marks the world as "goaled"
* "Charmander: Multiple" now requires Pokemon Food
* "Metapod: Wonderful" and "Metapod: Multiple" now require Pester Ball (technically possible, but quite hard)
* Course icon now matches hovered course in course selection menu

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nielrenned/PokemonSnap_Archipelago/compare/v0.2.1...v0.3.0

v0.4.0.description:
# New Features
* Added Secret Exits as checks
* Variety of soft logic changes to make some very hard checks a little easier (thanks @cobyw)
* Variety of FAQ updates (thanks @cobyw)
* Added default option to exclude RNG based photos from required checks (thanks @cobyw)
* Added damaged photos of the missing gen 1 pokemon to the pool as trash items (thanks @cobyw)

# Bug Fixes
* Universal Tracker v3 compatibility fix (thanks @SomeJakeGuy)
* Renamed "\<Pokemon\>: Wonderful!" items to "\<Pokemon\>: Good Technique" because Oak doesn't always say "Wonderful!"

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nielrenned/PokemonSnap_Archipelago/compare/v0.3.1...v0.4.0
